verdict.line: You lose trades and risk a solo-kill before level 6, but Teemo still wins 55.7% over 902 games by out-scaling K'Sante once mushrooms and core items come online.

brief.thesis: K'Sante owns the early lane and can solo-kill Teemo the moment R (All Out) comes online at 6, which is why the data calls this matchup a K'Sante lane advantage. But Teemo's win rate is still 55.7% because Toxic Shot poke, Move Quick kiting, and Noxious Trap zoning let him disengage the all-in and out-siege K'Sante in the mid-late game, where K'Sante has no ranged answer.

theirWindow.what: He knocks you through any wall in the path, then goes All Out and dashes after you with increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities. You cannot out-trade this state — disengage with W (Move Quick) speed and summoner mobility rather than fighting it.

yourWindow.when: W (Path Maker) or E (Footwork) just whiffed
yourWindow.what: Both are on real cooldowns (W: 14/13/12/11/10s, E: 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s). A missed dash means he has no gap-closer or shield for several seconds — walk up and free-hit with Toxic Shot.

powerCurve.note: Q (Ntofo Strikes) pokes faster than you trade
W engage plus R unlock threatens solo-kills
Toxic Shot ranks up, kiting matches his dashes
Core items and mushrooms outscale his engage

start.why: Doran's Ring into double Health Potion is the 70.7%-picked, 56.1% win rate start and feeds the AP poke build (Statikk Shiv into Liandry's) you're committing to against a melee bruiser you want to out-range, not out-stat.

boots.why: 54.2% win rate over 526 games. K'Sante's entire kit is dash-and-engage (W Path Maker, E Footwork, R All Out knockback) — flat movement speed is the direct counter to all three, letting you keep Move Quick's bonus speed uninterrupted.

core.why: First item on the 62.9%-win, 42.8%-pick path. Attack speed plus the on-hit proc stacks Toxic Shot faster for safer poke trades.
Second item on the same path. Burn damage scales directly off the poison DOT you're already applying every auto.
Third item, capping the 62.9% win-rate core build with magic penetration to keep poke relevant into K'Sante's rising resistances.

situational.when: you are ahead and want burst poke online before item three (the 75.6%-win Shiv-into-Malignance order)
k'sante builds health and you need the detonate-at-low-HP burst to finish mushroom and poke damage
the game goes long and you need attack speed scaling to keep toxic shot ticking during extended sieges

runes.keystoneWhy: 53.1% win rate, 30% pick. PTA's vulnerable mark rewards the sustained on-hit poke Toxic Shot already applies, and it punishes K'Sante for standing in auto range during trades.

summoners.why: 55.3% win rate at 90.7% pick rate. Ignite punishes K'Sante's lack of sustain in the early trading window the data names as his advantage, and Flash is your only answer to the R (All Out) wall-knockback engage.

playing.title: Poke from max E range
playing.detail: Toxic Shot applies on every auto at 0 cooldown. Stay at the edge of your attack range so you're landing poison stacks without entering K'Sante's 450-range Q (Ntofo Strikes).

playing.title: Blind the marked auto
playing.detail: K'Sante's passive, Dauntless Instinct, marks you after an ability for bonus damage on his next attack. Save Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) for that moment — blind fully negates the auto, wasting the mark.

playing.title: Track his Q stack count
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit, and at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that pulls you in. Back off before he reaches 2 stacks so you don't get dragged into melee range.

playing.title: Never let Move Quick get struck
playing.detail: W passively builds movement speed until an enemy champion or turret hits you. Losing that buff mid-trade erases the speed advantage you need to kite his dashes.

playing.title: Seed jungle entrances with mushrooms
playing.detail: Noxious Trap (1s cooldown, 230 range) placed in river and tri-brush punishes ganks and removes K'Sante's Footwork (E) flank angle before he commits.

playing.title: Respect the R timer, then ignore it
playing.detail: All Out is on a 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown. Play loose and take every farm opportunity once you've tracked it going down — it's his only hard engage.

playing.title: Siege with mushrooms after 6 items online
playing.detail: Once Liandry's and Malignance land, split lanes and trap walls/brushes to zone him off farm. This is where the 55.7% win rate is actually won — not in lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability breakdowns, cooldown call-outs, and tactical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top.
